title: Pause an Engineering Graph at a gate and cross it with an explicit approval
task: Engineering Graph control plane: the graph must pause at the review gate after the Agent node passes, and only an explicit approval on resume may release the downstream node.

nodes.task: `npm test` fails in this project. `compareVersions` in src/semver.js compares versions as plain strings, so "1.10.0" sorts before "1.9.0". Fix src/semver.js to compare each dot-separated part numerically, returning -1, 0, or 1. Do NOT edit anything under test/. Run `npm test` to verify.

notes: The first invocation is asserted to stop at "paused" (gate approval), which a graph that ignored the gate would fail before any check runs. The resume supplies approvedNodeIds for exactly that gate; verify-graph.mjs proves from the checkpoint that the gate really waited, that the resume was a resume (one graph.started, one graph.resumed), that the Agent ancestor was not replayed, and that the post-gate node only settled after the resume.
